title: Basic Solar Lighting Installation (12 V training rig)
summary: Install a 12 V solar lighting system on an isolated training rig: battery, PWM charge controller, panel and LED load. Connection order follows the controller manufacturer convention: battery first, then load, then panel. PROCEDURE PENDING REVIEW BY A QUALIFIED SOLAR TECHNICIAN.

steps.title: Identify the components
steps.description: Lay out all components on the bench and show them to the camera.
instructions: Place the solar panel, battery, charge controller, LED lamp and inline fuse on the bench.
Hold the camera so every component is in view.
expected_observations: All five components visible on the bench.

methods.camera_guidance: Wide shot of the whole bench.

steps.title: Inspect the battery
steps.description: Inspect the battery for physical damage before any connection.
instructions: Check the casing for cracks or swelling.
Inspect both terminals for corrosion.
Look for any leakage.

methods.camera_guidance: Close-up of the battery top and sides.

criteria.description: casing has no swelling or cracks

methods.prompt: I checked for leakage and found none.

requirements: Do not short-circuit the battery terminals.
Do not use a swollen or leaking battery.

common_mistakes.correction: Stop. Set the battery aside and ask your instructor for a replacement.

steps.title: Check the battery voltage
steps.description: Confirm the battery holds a usable charge.
instructions: Set the multimeter to DC volts (20 V range).
Red probe on battery +, black probe on battery −.
Enter the reading.

requirements: Never let the probe tips touch each other on the battery terminals.

common_mistakes.description: Battery is too discharged for installation
common_mistakes.correction: Do not continue. Charge the battery or ask for a charged one.

common_mistakes.description: Reading too high for a 12 V battery
common_mistakes.correction: Check the meter is on DC volts and you are measuring the battery.

steps.title: Isolate the system
steps.description: Make sure nothing is energised while wiring.
instructions: Cover the solar panel with an opaque cloth.
Remove the inline fuse from its holder.
Show the covered panel and the empty fuse holder to the camera.

methods.prompt: The panel is covered and the fuse is out.

requirements: Isolate all sources before making connections.

steps.title: Connect the battery to the charge controller
steps.description: Connect the battery cables to the controller BAT terminals, positive first.
instructions: Connect the red cable from battery + to the controller BAT+ terminal.
Connect the black cable from battery − to the controller BAT− terminal.
Tighten both screws with the insulated screwdriver.
Refit the inline fuse on the positive cable.
Measure across controller BAT+ (red probe) and BAT− (black probe).
expected_observations: Red cable on BAT+, black cable on BAT−.

methods.camera_guidance: Close-up of the controller battery terminals.

criteria.description: red cable connected to BAT+ terminal
black cable connected to BAT− terminal

methods.probe_points: controller BAT+ (red probe) to BAT− (black probe)

requirements: Connect the battery before the panel.
Never let the battery cables touch each other.
Verify polarity with the multimeter before continuing.

common_mistakes.description: Battery polarity is reversed at the controller
common_mistakes.correction: Remove the fuse, swap the two battery cables at the controller, refit the fuse and measure again.

common_mistakes.description: Red cable is not on BAT+
common_mistakes.correction: Remove the fuse and move the red cable to BAT+.
Check the fuse is fitted and both screws are tight.

steps.title: Connect the LED lighting load
steps.description: Connect the LED lamp to the controller LOAD terminals.
instructions: Connect the LED + lead to LOAD+.
Connect the LED − lead to LOAD−.
Tighten both terminals.

requirements: Do not let the load leads touch while the battery is connected.

steps.title: Connect the solar panel
steps.description: Connect the panel to the controller PV terminals, then uncover it.
instructions: With the panel still covered, connect panel + to PV+ and panel − to PV−.
Uncover the panel.
Measure across PV+ (red probe) and PV− (black probe).

methods.probe_points: controller PV+ (red probe) to PV− (black probe), panel uncovered

requirements: Keep the panel covered while connecting.

common_mistakes.description: Panel polarity is reversed at the controller
common_mistakes.correction: Cover the panel, swap the panel leads at PV+/PV−, uncover and measure again.
Make sure the panel is uncovered and in light, then measure again.

steps.title: Test the system
steps.description: Confirm the lamp works from the controller output.
instructions: Switch the controller load output on.
Check the LED lights.
Measure across LOAD+ and LOAD−.

methods.probe_points: controller LOAD+ (red probe) to LOAD− (black probe)

steps.title: Troubleshoot: inspect the wiring
steps.description: The test failed. Look for loose or wrong connections.
instructions: Check every terminal screw is tight.
Check the LED leads are on LOAD, not PV.
Check the load fuse, if fitted.

criteria.description: LED leads firmly on LOAD+ and LOAD−

steps.title: Secure and hand over
steps.description: Tidy the cables and put tools away.
instructions: Route cables so nothing is under strain.
Put tools away.
Show the finished rig to the camera.
